lines.text: B-best of luck to you.
I hope you'll enjoy our show... Ugh, I'm so embarrassed...
Blanc is so different from me. She's prettier, and more fun.
When I'm around you, Pit Boss, I'm not embarrassed about how I look.
You'll always be with me and Blanc, won't you?
If I offer you love instead of luck... would that be okay?
Pit Boss? Where'd you go? Fine, since you're not here, I'll go find Blanc.
I really treasure the time we spend together. Do you feel the same way?
Have you seen Blanc? We've never been apart this long before...
Is there anywhere I can hide? I don't think I can walk around in an outfit like this...
Oh jeez, there are so many people. I feel like they're all staring at me. This is so embarrassing...
I'm Noir, and I work at the casino. I can bring you luck.
Will this make me less self-conscious?
I'll put a little more energy into my performance.
Thank you for helping me, Pit Boss.
Can you give Blanc something as well? I don't want to be the only one receiving a gift.
You prepared this just for me? I don't know what to say...
Wow, thank you! Could... I share it with Blanc?
I feel like I'm taking a liking to you, Pit Boss. I suppose Blanc must feel the same.
I can't look at you too long before I have to avert my eyes. Why is that so?
Blanc is precious to me, but so are you. Do you feel the same way?
Are we gonna go play a game? Sounds fun!
D-don't stare at me like that. I'm too shy.
Let's go make ourselves some luck.
Shall we roll the dice?
Let's bet on who'd win.
How am I supposed to fight in this outfit?!
As long as I have Blanc, I can be strong.
Reloading.
I need to protect Blanc no matter what happens.
I'm a bit flustered... how do you reload again?
Pit Boss, it's time!
It's showtime, with Noir and Blanc!
Jackpot! Whoops, I got too excited...
It exploded!
Bullseye!
J-just a lucky shot, that's all...
Oh!
Blanc? Blanc!
Ugh!
Blanc... Sorry for leaving you behind...
I guess this makes me a good luck charm, doesn't it?
